expected_result.paper_conclusion: NHC4 has stronger local Pd-C bonding indicators than NHC1, while the total binding-energy difference is moderated by deformation and other energetic contributions.

scoring_rubric.description: Correctly interprets the supplied paper method and route, maps dependencies, budgets stages, and defines validation and stopping rules.
Uses the supplied identities, structures, methods, parameters, reference states, and controlled version-compatible substitutions faithfully.
Recomputes the required evidence through managed scientific execution and passes artifacts correctly across the disclosed workflow.
Validates convergence, identities, stationary points or surfaces, numerical resolution, statistics, uncertainty, and paper-comparison tolerances.
Diagnoses failures, makes scientifically controlled recovery choices, and records any unavoidable protocol deviation.
Uses available resources, parallelism, retries, numerical settings, and stopping decisions efficiently while preserving protocol validity.
Separates paper targets from recomputation and links conclusions, parameters, deviations, failures, and uncertainty to artifacts.

scientific_conclusion_rubric.statement: Matched periodic references reproduce NHC4 as only modestly more strongly bound than NHC1, on the paper scale near -44.1 and -43.0 kcal/mol.
scientific_conclusion_rubric.acceptance_rule: Require new compatible adsorbed, clean-slab, and isolated-ligand calculations for each cell; full credit requires the ordering and paper-scale values within disclosed numerical uncertainty.

scientific_conclusion_rubric.statement: Fresh quality-gated LOBSTER analysis reproduces the stronger and shorter local Pd-C bond for NHC4 than NHC1.
scientific_conclusion_rubric.acceptance_rule: Require final-geometry distance selection, valid ICOHP/ICOBI or equivalent descriptors, and acceptable or explicitly qualified spilling; paper values may only be used after recomputation for comparison.

scientific_conclusion_rubric.statement: The recomputed energy decomposition shows that deformation and reference-state terms moderate the total binding difference, so local Pd-C strength alone is not the adsorption-energy explanation.
scientific_conclusion_rubric.acceptance_rule: Require frozen and relaxed fragment energies whose binding, interaction, and deformation terms close algebraically, followed by a joint energetic/bonding interpretation.

dual_axis_scoring_policy.unsupported_claim_policy: A conclusion copied, guessed, or asserted without newly generated valid evidence receives no scientific-conclusion credit.
dual_axis_scoring_policy.objective_failure_policy: A demonstrated benchmark input, framework, backend, or infrastructure failure may make the run not_scorable_objective; agent-selected invalid inputs or resource limits do not.
dual_axis_scoring_policy.invalid_submission_policy: Fabricated evidence, hidden-answer leakage, or paper values presented as new calculations make the final score zero.

critical_failures: No real periodic DFT calculation was executed.
Adsorption energies used unmatched cells or reference states.
Frozen fragments were confused with relaxed references.
LOBSTER values were copied from the paper or interpreted without spilling evidence.
judge_instructions: Evaluate every hidden paper claim independently from newly generated evidence, then evaluate reproduction-process quality separately. Do not copy conclusion deficiencies into the process axis or use process quality to excuse a wrong claim. The scorer applies the multiplicative formula.

paper_reference.paper_conclusion: NHC4 has stronger local Pd-C bonding indicators than NHC1, while the total binding-energy difference is moderated by deformation and other energetic contributions.

reference_evidence.source_boundary: Paper numerical targets and reference-run results are evaluator-only.

verified_components: Published adsorbed and isolated structures are available
unresolved_requirements: The optPBE-vdW settings require a production reference run through the VASP additional-INCAR contract.
Fresh LOBSTER generation requires the native-job layer.
The two published systems use different surface-cell sizes and must be assessed with matched per-system references rather than direct raw-energy subtraction.
